title: Independently re-review writing-method corrections #489 against findings S1–S3
body:
## Goal
Report, do not fix. Independently review #489's narrow correction of review #485 findings S1–S3, including regressions against the original writing-method requirements. Expected gain: a pinned, evidenced recommendation that closes or retains each finding and tells the next shaper whether this synthetic design can advance. No session can run LabVIEW. A passing synthetic check is neither native validation, benchmark readiness, product quality nor owner method acceptance. Do not edit repository files or implement anything.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Pin the actual reviewed commit/tree and seven benchmark/writing file hashes. Prepared accepted checkout is d3c697c375ed7dc880e55ab3cc2219577cd133a5; resolve its tree using git. Match its writing bytes to #489's seven final hashes before reviewing. The author checkpoint f86939aed871aee754a096d9b378870ebb39d095 / tree 50a0180535642f6fda877a5acea9e4c3801acd51 is evidence, not an assumed published identity. If starting main differs, distinguish administrative changes from reviewed-byte drift and report missing pinned evidence rather than silently substituting it.
- [ ] Compare correction bytes with original reviewed candidate 7435c05c4fd7ddbaafb6f5db9081ad5a4f5db427 / tree 555960a979f4bec474850a39bd9b284b7188496a and inspect original #481 requirements plus #485 findings. Record actual changed paths and separate Standards and Spec assessments. Verify method.json remains unchanged and no protected protocol/index/status/input bytes were modified.
- [ ] S1: independently resolve historical baseline 486030b461e57ca0f322a17a5b7853e83e9655e3 / tree cf75cf6892de2f9410fa09ee2589dcba47d825a4; check corrected identities, all 62 protected hashes and 56 unique preparation-index pins (74 references). Establish provenance from git/bytes, not the author's assertion. Do not replace this baseline with a session checkpoint.
- [ ] S2: independently recreate the ordinary-modification and source-rebuild counterexamples: preserved original and original_after SYNTHETIC-v0 while output/frozen remain SYNTHETIC-v1. Confirm rejection for version drift on the corrected checker, retaining legitimate modification, rebuild and creation positives. Inspect whether both frozen expectations and original linkage are enforced, and test a bounded adjacent version case independently of authored controls.
- [ ] S3: derive mandatory pair settings from original protocol/runner/writing requirements, rather than copying the new constant. Independently remove key_revision from frozen and both arms, then each other required setting; confirm rejection. Check individual-arm/frozen omissions and mismatched values remain rejected, and legitimate paired-arm invariants remain intact. Record exact mutations and observed reasons.
- [ ] Independently run the checker: confirm 35 original rejecting controls retained, nine added controls and five positives; inspect changed control content and reported hashes/counts. Repeat from another working directory with empty environment using an isolated subprocess; confirm it needs neither LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT nor session artifacts, network or writes. Independently reproduce relevant old false acceptances from original git bytes in memory or session artifacts when available, and distinguish unavailable evidence from a pass.
- [ ] Report findings with severity, file/line evidence, exact reproduction and concrete consequence; give a separate closed/open verdict for S1, S2 and S3 and an overall recommendation. Store lengthy replay evidence under .session/artifacts/ and summarize enough in the report for a cold shaper without those artifacts. Keep remaining native/resource/isolation/owner prerequisites and zero native executions explicit. A recommendation applies only to this pinned synthetic design; do not approve implementation or request owner acceptance. Parent commits; no git commit.
## Verification
python3 -I benchmark/writing/verify_method.py
## Context
- .session/reports/489.json (or exported report): accepted author correction, seven final hashes, checkpoint caveat and remaining prerequisites.
- benchmark/writing/review-corrections.json: exact nine before/after mutations, original reviewed identities, protected-input claims and contract derivations to verify independently.
- #485 report: independent REVISE findings S1–S3; #481 report and iteration 0094 task: original extension requirements.
- docs/perpetua/evaluation.md and docs/perpetua/roles.md: authoritative readiness and independent-review boundaries.
## Budget
Read .session/exports/manifest.json and exported reports #481, #485, #489; .session/history/records/0094.json only its writing task body if needed; benchmark/writing/README.md, method.json, controls.json, verify_method.py, verification.json, input-pins.json and review-corrections.json; goal/goal.md writing requirements; docs/perpetua/evaluation.md and roles.md; benchmark/protocol.md paired-comparison clauses and benchmark/baseline/runner-contract.md relevant setting definitions. Inspect protected inputs via bounded hash checks rather than whole-file dumps. At most three further directly linked excerpts for concrete discrepancies. Keep command output to identities, changed paths, counts and mutation verdicts. Do not repeat POC reverse engineering, corpus searches, global gap maps, unrelated allocator review or product work. Save report early if evidence is unavailable.
